about: Instructions each benchmark's measured region runs, counted by Callgrind on x86-64 Linux at the AVX2 SIMD level. CI fails a pull request that makes any of them more than 3 % higher; change them only with `cargo xtask bench --update-baseline --reason ...`, and say why in the pull request.
reason: R1.2 adds lspk-wavetable's benchmarks: a 256-frame table loading with its mipmaps, a 4-frame spectral morph to 256 frames with its mipmaps, and a 512-sample block read; the example plug-ins' create and load-state counts move by under 0.4 % with main's R0.7 merge.
